text.description_html:
Acorn PR8YP, Floral Aloha Ceramic Cabinet Knob

Acorn's Aloha Ceramic Cabinet Knob is perfect for bringing the surfer spirit to your home. The Flower Cabinet Knob has a 1-3/4" diameter. It is perfect for all sorts of applications, be it in the kitchen, the bathroom, or on any light weight door. It is available in two colors. The picture really doesn't due this cabinet pull justice. The hand painted colors round cabinet knobs are vibrant to mimic the Aloha spirit of the beach.

Features of the Hand Painted Aloha Ceramic Cabinet Knob:

  • Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
